notes.title: First patch for the game was released
notes.content:
We have released the first patch for our game. Here is the list of the fixes that were made for the game:
+ Added mouse inversion
+ Fixed some grammar errors
+ Motion blur has been disabled
+ Fixed some bugs with collisions
+ Improved sword damage system
+ Bugs related to Steam were fixed
+ Partially improved graphics in the last level
+ Some bugs related to sounds were fixed

notes.title: Future plans - Axilon: Legend of Artifacts
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Thank you for your kind comments regarding our game. We would like to thank you. Soon we will release a patch that will fix some bugs in the game, as well as improving hitboxes on enemies, and an axis inversions of the mouse will be added to the game.

On the first day, our game was downloaded by about 30 thousand people, which is great. But we want to say that, first of all, this game is an experimental project and it is not our main project, therefore the game may not have detailed settings, and the combat system and the plot are not of sufficient quality.

Now all our efforts are directed to the development of our game “Evade The Light”, so if you to support our team in development, please add it to the wishlist. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1601870/Evade_The_Light/

In addition to this, if the popularity of the current version of Axilon game will only grow, we may well go to the full version of this game.
